title: IndiGo Suspends Flights Amid Iran Tensions
description: IndiGo Airlines has cancelled its flights to Tbilisi, Almaty, Tashkent, and Baku until January 28, citing safety concerns due to tensions between Iran and the United States. The airline is avoiding Iranian airspace and is assessing alternative routes as part of its safety measures.
